recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If this behavior regresses later, update the kindling publisher dependency or its pinned version rather than restoring or editing retired in-repository Java tooling.
issue_request: FHIR-8520 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking the build to raise an error when duplicate profile ids are encountered, instead of silently letting one profile overwrite another.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6157. Git-svn commit 389772eae769faca08a64c0a2e1f5bc3067d95b1 corresponds to that revision and applied #8520 by adding uniqueness checks for value set, code system, profile URL, and pack id handling in the old in-repository Java publisher.
additional_context: The source files changed in 2015 were later removed when commit 9f549566d1346cad7db6d2afca6080d7cebdfbbe switched the FHIR build to the external kindling Gradle dependency. Current build.gradle.kts and gradle.properties use org.hl7.fhir:kindling:1.25.5-SNAPSHOT, while source/fhir.ini still defines active [profiles] inputs. Current kindling source and the cached jar both contain Duplicate Pack id and Duplicate Profile Name checks.
reconciliation: No source change was needed in this FHIR checkout. The requested duplicate profile id failure behavior is already present in the current publisher path, and the old in-repository Java implementation is no longer build-scope source.
